inclusion_rules: The member action is inside the declared House, Congress, session, date, and service boundary.
The exact action has an official House Clerk identity and resolved member action.
The exact action is substantive rather than a rule, previous-question vote, recommit/commit motion, tabling/referral/discharge motion, or other procedural control.
Congress.gov assigns the acted-on measure to Crime and Law Enforcement or Law, or the governed seven-action benchmark supplies exact-action Justice membership.
Present or Not Voting actions may remain in the universe as non-directional records; they do not become support or opposition evidence.
exclusion_rules: Keyword recall alone cannot establish Justice membership.
Parent-measure or rule context cannot establish the issue eligibility of a narrower exact action.
Procedural controls remain context-only and non-counting.
Actions assigned by official metadata to another policy area are excluded unless carried explicitly for human boundary review.
Actions after 2026-06-11 are outside this content-addressed snapshot and require a later refresh.
